overview.title: Program Overview
overview.description: Offered only at the Richardson campus, PCI's Dental Assistant program is a comprehensive, immersive training that combines classroom instruction, hands-on lab work in dental procedures, and an off-site externship to prepare students to take dental X-rays, assist with dental procedures, and manage administrative tasks using dental software.

curriculum.title: What You Will Learn
curriculum.description: The curriculum blends classroom theory with lab practice and an externship to teach clinical and administrative dental skills.

items.title: Classroom Topics
items.description: Anatomy and physiology, clinical procedures, preparing patients for treatment, chairside assisting, and radiology.

items.title: Lab Skills
items.description: Performing basic dental procedures, identifying and using dental instruments, and preparing materials for chairside assisting.

items.title: Externship
items.description: Off-site externship at a dental office to gain real-world experience.

handsOnTraining.title: Hands-On Training
handsOnTraining.description: Practical training in dental operatories and labs under instructor supervision.

items.title: Chairside Assisting
items.description: Hands-on practice assisting during dental procedures.

items.title: Radiology / X-rays
items.description: Training to perform x-rays as part of clinical skills.

items.title: Dental Procedures & Instruments
items.description: Perform basic dental procedures and learn proper use of dental instruments and materials.

externship.title: Supervised Clinical Externship
externship.description: Complete your training with a structured placement at a local dental practice, where you'll practice chairside assisting, patient communication, and office workflows bridging classroom learning to real-world employment.
